definitions.explanation: Third-person plural pronoun, traditionally referring to males or mixed groups.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}ら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{彼|かれ}ら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いてみましょう→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
{彼|かれ}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
{彼|かれ}ら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}している→練習する：05323_renshuu⟧。
{彼|かれ}ら⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けておこう→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's tidy the room before they come.

notes:
{彼|かれ}ら is the third-person plural pronoun, formed from ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧ (he) + ⟦ら→ら：noentry⟧ (plural suffix).

TRADITIONAL USAGE:
- All-male groups
- Mixed-gender groups

MODERN USAGE:
Increasingly used gender-neutrally, especially in writing.

GRAMMAR:
- {彼|かれ}ら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: they (subject)
- {彼|かれ}ら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: their
- {彼|かれ}ら⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: to them
- {彼|かれ}ら⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: them (object)

PRONOUN SYSTEM:
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧: he → {彼|かれ}ら: they (m/mixed)
- ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧: she → ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}たち→彼女たち：23330_kanojotachi⟧: they (f)
- ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧: I → ⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧: we
- ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: that person → ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧: those people

NOTE:
In everyday speech, Japanese often omits pronouns. ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧ is less direct than {彼|かれ}ら.
